placements.title: Ownership of perspective, not the substrate it runs on, is the durable asset
placements.frame: Does this expression value a capability by whether its perspective layer is owned and retained, as against a substrate treated as an interchangeable commodity?
placements.why: src-2 and src-3 jointly perform one maxim-shaped thesis — owned intelligence differs from rented intelligence because the substrate is commoditized while the perspective is the asset kept — read across affect (calm-positive conviction), register (plain-spoken maxim), value (autonomy/self-enhancement), style (metaphor of perspective-as-asset), and conviction (principle-grade, bedrock permanence). This is a subject future envelopes can keep feeding (the grain test), not a one-time fact, so it earns its own leaf rather than joining an existing one — none exists in this repo yet. Placed under the newly minted Strategy stratum since it is a positioning thesis, not architecture, product, or proof content.
